messages:
jess_support: Customer acme-123 onboarding stuck — free trial not granted because payment flow never completes. They hit a 'payment_required' state and our UI keeps prompting for card. Payment Intent: pi_1F2abcXYZ. Logs show ACS redirect but no webhook. Can we look?

Tom_prodops: Can you share the payment_intent id + rough timestamps and whether they saw any error in the UI?

jess_support: pi_1F2abcXYZ created 2024-11-12T14:05:21Z. Repro steps from customer: 1) enter card, 2) checkout POST -> returns requires_action, 3) redirect to ACS page, 4) ACS loads blank page, user closes it. Browser console: POST https://acs.issuer-bank.example/verify 403. Our gateway shows status stuck 'requires_action' and no final webhook. Happened twice with two different cards from same issuer.

maya_payments: Are we using Cardinal or a direct gateway? Also which Checkout SDK version?

jess_support: Hosted Redwood Checkout v0.9.7, gateway stripe w/ Cardinal broker. Trace id: trace_8f3cb. I pasted the minimal server logs: ```2024-11-12T14:05:22Z payment_intent=pi_1F2abcXYZ status=requires_action acs_url=https://acs.issuer-bank.example/verify```. Then nothing.

dan_engineer: Looping in @eng-sre. Note: we recently changed webhook retry backoff logic to treat 4xx from ACS broker as non-retryable when rate-limited — might be too aggressive. If ACS proxy returns 403 it should still allow a few more attempts.

eng-sre-bot: deploy-bot: cardinal-proxy v2024-11-12-1318 deployed to prod at 2024-11-12T13:18:02Z :rotating_light:

maya_payments: Sounds like cardinal-proxy returning a 403 on POST->issuer. If our proxy logs show repeated 403/401, issuer might be blocking our IPs or there is a header mismatch.

billing_ops: We can do a manual trial credit while payments investigate. What email/account do we need?

jess_support: Account: acme-123, email ops@acme.com. Customer is in a signup flow, please mark urgent.

tom_prodops: Short-term workaround options: 1) manual free credit grant 2) set account flag to bypass trial payment requirement (skip_card_onboarding) — last is risky for SCA/regulatory reasons. @security fyi.

security: We cannot bypass 3DS requirement without contract/PO & legal signoff. Manual credits only.

dan_engineer: Action items: 1) payments to pull cardinal-proxy logs for trace_8f3cb and confirm 403 origin 2) eng-sre to revert/patch webhook retry policy to tolerate transient 403s for a short window 3) billing_ops to grant 1000 free tokens to acme-123 4) support to update customer with ETA. I'll open INF-4321 and attach traces.

maya_payments: Also check if issuer responded with an HTML challenge that our redirect handler treats as an error (blank page). We saw similar for issuer X where Content-Security blocked the frame. If so, we need to surface better error in Checkout ("issuer returned unsupported challenge").

billing_ops: Manual grant scheduled, actioned by 2024-11-12T15:00Z.

jess_support: I'll update the customer: manual credits applied, payments investigating, ETA ~4 hours. Will follow up with logs. Thanks everyone. :white_check_mark:
